sentence: This project tests in a rodent model whether brain stimulation improves fear and impulsivity after blast brain injury.
This project tests whether a 3D printed cardiac model improves visualization of device placement sites compared with 2D imaging in patients with congenital heart disease.
This project builds a test that uses AI and CRISPR to detect drug-resistant tuberculosis early.
This project brings together scientists who study viruses and prions to work on protecting people from infectious diseases.
This project studies how the control of transcription helps human embryo cells become liver cells.
This project uses a supercomputer to simulate large biomolecular systems and makes the results available to the biomedical community.
This project builds targeted mass spectrometry methods for measuring proteins in cancer research.
This project engineers a baculovirus that infects mosquitoes into a tool for changing their genes.
This project tries to find out how the body senses and regulates osmolarity by mapping neural circuits of water consumption.
This project studies how niche cells grow to support stem cells in a microscopic worm.
This project builds a computer system that uses MRI to detect prostate cancer and assess how aggressive it is.
This project builds a deep learning platform that automatically measures features in kidney electron microscopy images.
This project builds a model of endothelial cell aging using human cells to find processes that contribute to dementia.
This project studies the neural mechanisms behind strategy switching and problem-solving using computational modeling and neural recordings.
This project combines imaging, artificial intelligence and mobile app tracking to improve early diagnosis of Temporomandibular Degenerative Joint Disease, especially in children.
This project studies how transcription factors control histone modifications that help human beta cells mature and secrete insulin.
This project studies how the human genome is regulated as cells develop, and how cancer cells switch state.
This project builds a computational method that analyzes microscopic images of a patient's cancer to characterize immune cells around the tumor.
This project uses x-ray crystallography and electron microscopy to study how antibodies respond to trimer immunogens and to improve their design.
This project studies why a specific type of lung cell builds up in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and tests a compound that blocks a pathway.
